//: Playwright loads a tsconfig to transpile the specs, and resolves an `extends` itself rather than through tsc. The repo's root tsconfig extends `@grafana/tsconfig` by bare module name, which Playwright 1.62 cannot resolve, so the whole e2e run dies before a single test with 'Failed to resolve extends path @grafana/tsconfig'. This file is what playwright.config.ts points at: no extends, just enough to compile the specs. `npm run typecheck` still uses the real one.
